description: Footer disclaimer text using faint light grey text (#e2e8f0) on white background violating contrast standards.
summary: Low contrast for footer disclaimer text violating accessibility standards.

issues.issue: The footer disclaimer text has insufficient color contrast against the white background, violating WCAG accessibility standards.
issues.evidence: The text starting with '* Notice: By clicking submit...' is rendered in a very light grey color, making it barely legible against the white card background.
issues.probable_cause: The use of a light grey hex code (e.g., #e2e8f0) for text on a white background fails to meet the minimum contrast ratio required for readability.
